PreceptDef.label: adoptive kinship
PreceptDef.description: Adopted children are full kin. Becoming an adoptive parent gives +6 mood for eight days. Refusing an adoption request gives colonists with this belief -3 mood for four days.

PreceptDef.label: adoption accepted
PreceptDef.description: Adoption is a respected way to grow a family. Becoming an adoptive parent gives +3 mood for eight days. Refusing adoption carries no belief penalty.

PreceptDef.label: neutral
PreceptDef.description: Blood ties and adoptive ties are private family matters. This belief adds no adoption or refusal mood effects.

PreceptDef.label: bloodline primacy
PreceptDef.description: Blood ties are considered the strongest family bond. Adoption remains possible, but becoming an adoptive parent gives -2 mood for five days.
